description:
yeTTY is an open source application for embedded developers to
view logs from serial port.

Features:

• Text highlighting

• Auto reconnection

• Audio alert on string match

• Long term run mode

• Suspend during flashing

• Auto baud rate detection

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
